statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty'); branch=$(git -c core.useBuiltinFSMonitor=false -c core.fsmonitor=false branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo ''); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // empty'); remaining=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); out=""; [ -n "$cwd" ] && out="$out$cwd "; [ -n "$branch" ] && out="$out[$branch] "; [ -n "$model" ] && out="$out$model"; [ -n "$remaining" ] && out="${out} | ${remaining}% remaining"; echo "$out"
